constraints.note: Mike's per-run brief overrides the defaults: EXACTLY 3 clips, every clip under 60 s after tighten. Applied as 3 full clips on 3 topics, no impact variants (an impact slice of a sub-60 s full would be redundant and would spend one of the 3 slots), every raw span held under 60 s (57.35 / 55.45 / 58.27 s) so tighten lands them in the low 50s. This is a 44-minute Sunday stream that is mostly market narration, a Discord gems walkthrough, chart narration and a swing-trade-software demo; three clips is the honest count, not a shortfall (topic-finding SKILL: when a stream gives you nothing but market talk, come back with fewer clips and say so).

topics.hook_summary: As of this month software engineering is completely wiped out, and me as a code monkey, I am in the know: nobody is writing code anymore, it is just AI writing the code. Every single profession is at risk, there is one robot in your house and that is coming within a couple of years.

topics.hook_type: project-hype + outsized prediction with a reason
topics.hook_summary: Very, very bullish on Gram, on TON: over a billion monthly users on Telegram, every crypto mini app has to run on TON, the built-in wallet is rolled out to the user base. It is $1.26 right now, all-time high was $7.88, and it is probably gonna beat its all-time high.

This is going to be one of the last opportunities any of us have to actually get ahead: AI is exploding exponentially, jobs get taken away, everything becomes so goddamn cheap. Buy into those assets right now, before all this happens. One year ago it was not like this; imagine one year from now.

clips.title: One of the Last Chances Any of Us Have to Get Ahead

segments.why: HOOK + THESIS: 'I do think this is going to be one of the last opportunities that any of us have to actually get ahead, because the amount of advancement because of AI is just exploding at an exponential level. So many jobs taken away and everything is going to become so goddamn cheap. It is going to be difficult for anybody to make a decent amount of money, buy assets. So you got to buy into those assets right now, before all this happens, right?' Starts after the dangling But; ends on right? before 'And it is happening' / the copywriters-radiologists aside.

THE OPEN LOOP: 'Just think one year ago, the things I am talking about now that are happening right now, in October 2026, one year ago it was not like this. This was like, oh, maybe that will happen a year or two or three years from now... And now it has changed. Imagine what it is going to be like one year from now.' Pulled from 6.5 min later (11:35-12:00). Ends on now, before 'Let us just finish this video'.
